conditions.notes: Initially presented with sinusitis, pulmonary nodules, and hematuria. Renal biopsy showed pauci-immune crescentic glomerulonephritis. Diagnosed as ANCA-associated vasculitis, PR3-ANCA positive per this facility.

Patient initially evaluated at Mercy Hospital 6 months before City General diagnosis. Records indicate: 'Suspected Eosinophilic Granulomatosis with Polyangiitis (EGPA) based on peripheral eosinophilia and asthma history. MPO-ANCA positive. Recommend further workup.' Patient sought second opinion at City General.
Adult-onset, moderate persistent. Uses inhaled corticosteroids.
Recurrent episodes, nasal crusting. May be vasculitis-related.

social_history.exercise: Limited due to fatigue and dyspnea
